notes.title: Game day with developer
notes.content:
Good to see you.
We're the developers of Happy World.
Our game is not complete yet.
But thank you for buying our game.

I want your opinion to make us a better game.
Also, I want to improve by playing games together.
I'd like you to leave your opinion on the game in the steam store.

So I'm trying to set a game time for us to play together for a certain period of time.
We will be online for [u][b]2 hours from 6pm on May 31, 2019.[/b][/u]
Based on European time.
If you connect at this time, you will be able to play games with us.
Steam
I will wait
